metadata.name: Kansas Airport Improvement Program (KAIP)
metadata.agency: Kansas Department of Transportation (KDOT); Kansas Aviation Division
metadata.source_citation: KAIP FY26 Guidelines (aviation.ks.gov/files/KAIP_FY26_Guidlines_EffJan1_2025.pdf). Three documented project categories: System Preservation, Modernization, Design/Planning. Local match 5-50% by category. ~$19M FY2026 ($53 projects).

decisions_log.author: APH m49 Sprint 11 reference encoder
decisions_log.decision: Encoded Kansas with KAIP's 3 documented project categories as set-asides. Stated goal: 'maintain system runway condition rating of very good; minimize surface travel time to air ambulance pick-up; enhance airport/community economic development.'
decisions_log.rationale: Template-style encoding using documented program structure and common state-aviation-funding scoring patterns.
decisions_log.source: KAIP FY26 Guidelines (aviation.ks.gov/files/KAIP_FY26_Guidlines_EffJan1_2025.pdf). Three documented project categories: System Preservation, Modernization, Design/Planning. Local match 5-50% by category. ~$19M FY2026 ($53 projects).

criteria.label: Safety
criteria.description: Highest-priority category. RSA, obstruction removal, approach surfaces, signage, lighting safety upgrades.

criteria.label: System Preservation (KAIP category)
criteria.description: Maintains existing infrastructure. Pavement rehab, lighting/NAVAID preservation, building maintenance.

criteria.label: Federal Funding Leverage
criteria.description: Match for FAA AIP/BIL discretionary or entitlement grants.

criteria.label: Air Ambulance Access Improvement
criteria.description: KAIP stated goal: minimize surface travel time to air ambulance pick-up locations.

subcategories.label: Consistent with current Master Plan / ALP

governance.decision_authority: Kansas Department of Transportation (KDOT); Kansas Aviation Division
governance.scoring_authority: Kansas Department of Transportation (KDOT); Kansas Aviation Division
governance.approval_process: State aviation agency staff scores applications against published program structure; transportation commission or aeronautics commission approves annual program.

disclaimer: TEMPLATE-STYLE ENCODING per KAIP FY26 Guidelines. Kansas Aviation Division publishes program structure and 3 project categories (System Preservation, Modernization, Design/Planning) plus local-match ranges but does not publish a numerical scoring matrix. Kansas stakeholders should reference KDOT's annual program announcements for actual award rationale.

set_asides.label: System Preservation Projects (KAIP)
set_asides.eligibility_filter: Maintenance, repair, and rehabilitation of existing facilities. Local match 5-10%.

set_asides.label: Modernization Projects (KAIP)
set_asides.eligibility_filter: Increase capacity, resolve line-of-sight problems, new facilities. Local match 25-50%.

set_asides.label: Design / Planning Projects (KAIP)
set_asides.eligibility_filter: Evaluate and establish priorities for the airport's continued use.
